text:
Mia: Quick weekly sync on ACME account — variant flux after the last canary. TL;DR: new model v2 uptake ~28% of calls (was 3%), overall calls steady, but fallbacks jumped to 6.8% (from 0.9%). 95p latency increased ~120ms -> 350ms on long-context P99. Spend +22% month-over-month even though active users +2%. Need quick mitigation and a short customer note.

Raj: Can you paste per-route fallback rates?

Mia: Pasting top 3 routes: /chat/compose 11.2% fallback, /kg/query 4.6%, /summarize 0.9%. Full CSV attached in thread (link below). @cs-bot generated the perf snapshot. :eyes:

cs-bot: Autogenerated report: https://redwood-internal/reports/acme/1822334455 — contains per-route breakdown, seq_len distribution, cost delta.

Jordan: Looks like /chat/compose is the hotspot — mostly long prompts (>2048) triggering v2 edge-case. Recommend temp rollback or route long-context traffic back to v1.

Eli: I dug into logs — suspect quantization/tokenizer mismatch on v2 for sequences >3k tokens. Example error seen in logs.

Jordan: Sample query I used to pull fallbacks:
```sql
SELECT route, SUM(calls) AS calls, SUM(fallbacks) AS fallback_count, ROUND(100.0*SUM(fallbacks)/SUM(calls),2) AS fallback_pct
FROM telemetry
WHERE model IN ('v1','v2') AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY fallback_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Eli: Found sample log snippet:
```json
{"model":"v2","error":"tokenizer_index_out_of_range","context_len":4096,"request_id":"req_0a1b2c"}
```

Mia: I just created a temporary routing rule: seq_len > 2048 -> v1 for 2 hours (canary rollback) and enabled increased prefix caching for ACME. Monitoring dashboards updated.

acme_pm: Thanks. Can you send a short SLA impact note and the mitigation steps we should share with the customer? Renewal review is next week, want to be proactive.

Mia: Drafting now. Will include: explanation, immediate mitigation (routing rollback + cache change), ETA for fix (tokenizer patch), and monitoring plan + alert thresholds. Sending draft in ~20m.

Raj: I'll add a per-route alert: fallback_rate > 2% for 5m -> page on-call and create an ops ticket. Also tagging billing to hold any automated overage adjustments until we confirm root cause.

Eli: I'll push tokenizer bounds fix + unit test. ETA EOD. If we need a hotfix earlier, I can cut one within 90m.

Jordan: I'll prepare the rollback runbook and opt-out flags for ACME routes so the PM can toggle if needed.

Mia: Action items: Raj — new alert + billing hold; Jordan — rollback runbook; Eli — tokenizer patch/hotfix; Mia — customer comms draft. Will post follow-ups here after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:

Raj: Noted. Will also surface cost delta to finance for the renewal deck.

Mia: Thanks all — ping me if you see fallback_rate spike further.
